arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
# Total balance values (in millions) from Unemployment Trust Fund
values = {
    1936: 18.9,
    1937: 312.4,
    1938: 884.2,
    1939: 1280.5,
    1940: 1724.9,
    1941: 2283.7,
    1942: 3150.1
}

# Calculate 4-year moving averages
# For FY 1936-1942, we have 7 years of data
# 4-year moving averages: 1936-1939, 1937-1940, 1938-1941, 1939-1942

moving_avgs = []
for start_year in range(1936, 1940):  # 1936, 1937, 1938, 1939
    end_year = start_year + 3  # 4-year window
    total = sum(values[y] for y in range(start_year, end_year + 1))
    avg = total / 4
    moving_avgs.append((start_year, end_year, avg))
    print(f"FY {start_year}-{end_year}: ({values[start_year]} + {values[start_year+1]} + {values[start_year+2]} + {values[start_year+3]}) / 4 = {total} / 4 = {avg}")

print("\nMoving averages (rounded to tenths):")
moving_avg_values = []
for start, end, avg in moving_avgs:
    rounded = round(avg, 1)
    moving_avg_values.append(rounded)
    print(f"FY {start}-{end}: {rounded}")

print(f"\nRange: {min(moving_avg_values)} to {max(moving_avg_values)}")
print(f"Min: {min(moving_avg_values)}, Max: {max(moving_avg_values)}")
EOF

    start_idx = i
    end_idx = i + 3  # 4 years inclusive

print("\nRounded to tenths:")
rounded_avgs = [round(avg, 1) for avg in moving_avgs]
for i, avg in enumerate(rounded_avgs):

print(f"\nRange: {min(rounded_avgs)} to {max(rounded_avgs)}")
